description: This file defines the LDAPUserSyncAPI class, a REST API endpoint for synchronizing LDAP users within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for initiating sync, retrieving sync status, and handles LDAP configuration validation.

classes.name: LDAPUserSyncAPI
classes.description: A REST API class for LDAP user synchronization, handling LDAP sync requests, status retrieval, and validation within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles LDAP user sync trigger, validates LDAP settings, updates sync status, and initiates sync process.

methods.name: saveLDAPSyncStatus
methods.description: Persists LDAP sync status to database.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the latest LDAP sync status.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for create operation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for getOne operation.
